attributes.natural language caption: An adult male with short brown hair is seen walking in a warehouse setting. He is wearing a sleeveless yellow high-visibility safety vest that has reflective grey stripes and a small, unidentifiable dark logo on the left chest. Beneath the vest, he wears a long-sleeved black shirt. His lower body is dressed in long black pants, and he is wearing black boots. For protection, he has a yellow hard hat on his head.
